head: AndroSnitch: old Chrome versions let hackers into Android phones
dek: Security firm Sekoia warns of AndroSnitch, malware that infects Android phones with Qualcomm chips through fake websites, using flaws in old Chrome versions and a graphics driver. Both are fixed in updates.
details: It needs no click: opening a tampered website in an outdated Chrome is enough. The malware copies passwords and other data. Chrome versions before 145 are at risk, except 143; the current version is 157. Attacks were seen mainly in August, September and October, aimed especially at the US and Ukraine.
where: Android phones with Qualcomm chips and old Chrome versions
means: If you haven't updated Chrome on Android in months, a website alone could infect your phone.
todo: Update Chrome from the Play Store and install the latest Android system update under Settings.
